T1_DIRECT_PROOF.goal: Promote locally implemented semantics by adding exact executable proof.
T1_DIRECT_PROOF.minimum_profile: QP1 hosted reference, unless requirement states otherwise

T2_HIGH_FIDELITY.goal: Raise hosted implementation fidelity and measurable behavior to the requirement's full local semantics.
T2_HIGH_FIDELITY.minimum_profile: QP1/WQ2+; may require WQ3/WQ4 for presentation/scale semantics

T3_FABRIC.goal: Demonstrate deterministic spawned-worker/partitioned behavior rather than only single-process simulation.
T3_FABRIC.minimum_profile: Hosted fabric worker profile plus deterministic conformance; QP2/QP3 only if native/production is actually shown

T4_PRODUCTION_EXTERNAL.goal: Execute the actual production/hardware/independent environment named by the requirement.
